base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production sprite atlas of ten illustrated magical auras for an e-ink fantasy reading RPG. One landscape sheet, exactly 5 columns and 2 rows of equal cells, each cell containing a complete separate aura, generous blank gutters, no labels. Every aura is a vertically oval, lively swirling magical halo surrounding an EMPTY central space where a standing character will be placed later; include a beautiful curved arc above the head, wisps or ornament along the sides, and an elliptical energy pool below the feet so the result feels integrated, not two vertical lines. Ten motifs in reading order: radiant sun and rays; crescent moon and stars; curling fire and embers; frost crystals; curling wind and feathers; leafy vines and blossoms; lightning and sparks; flowing water and droplets; arcane runes and sparks (invented symbols only); celestial constellation and radiance. Style: finely drawn black ink, expressive fantasy storybook engraving with bold clear contours and restrained stipple shading, elegant stylized illustration, crisp readable at small monochrome resolution. Pure black ink and transparent background, no colored glow or gray blur. Centers mostly empty/transparent, decorative effects coherent around the whole oval, not opaque panels. No people, faces, bodies, animals, garments, weapons, interface, frames, text or numbers. All ten drawings fully inside their own cells with margins, never touching a neighboring cell. Consistent scale and ground line.
